Bihar politician demands resignation over Jamui incident

Tejashwi Yadav, a Bihar politician, has demanded the resignation of CM Samrat Choudhary following an incident in Jamui. The incident has also brought scrutiny to the sexualized imagery within the Bhojpuri industry. A leader from JD(U) commented on the Jamui molestation, suggesting a comparison to Bihar before 2005. Rahul Gandhi and Tejashwi Yadav have criticized the Bihar government, stating the incident is "not culture."
